summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of Eurasia Receivals app. 16/16 backend pytest tests passed (auth, verify-pin, suppliers/statuses/staff CRUD, receivals create/list/update/delete, file serving, archive preview). Frontend E2E via Playwright covered: ProtectedRoute redirect, admin JWT login, new receival flow (supplier select, pallet count, dispute toggle, observation, item add, camera fallback file upload, signature canvas draw, PIN confirm), wrong-PIN rejection, list rendering, per-row supplier reassignment, checklist toggle persistence across reload, search filter, details page with image gallery, Settings tabs (Suppliers/Statuses/Staff/Archive) visible, and delete. All critical flows work.

issues: Success toast (top-center) partially overlaps the top nav 'Receivals' link — cosmetic only, dismisses automatically.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/suppliers, /api/statuses and /api/files/{path} are unauthenticated (public). Suppliers/statuses is fine as the login page may need them, but consider requiring auth for /api/files to avoid enumeration of user-uploaded photos/signatures by anyone who guesses a path.

server.py: create_receival (POST /api/receivals) is unauthenticated and relies only on staff PIN. Anyone with a valid PIN (4 digits, brute-forceable) can create receivals from anywhere on the internet. Consider requiring the JWT in addition to the PIN, or add rate-limiting/lockout on /verify-pin and POST /receivals.
PINs stored in plaintext (db.staff.pin) and queried by equality — should be hashed and iterated for verification. Currently a single collection scan by pin equality also enables timing side-channels.
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to lifespan handlers for future FastAPI compatibility.

CORS: allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origins='*' (default from env) is invalid per CORS spec and will be rejected by browsers when a specific origin is needed with credentials. Prefer setting CORS_ORIGINS explicitly to the frontend origin.

Frontend ReceivalListPage optimistic updates for toggle/reassign don't roll back the local state on failure — only re-fetch via load(); UX-wise OK but the toast + load() ordering could show stale state briefly.
Signature canvas uses fixed width=600/height=220 while displayed responsively — image quality is fine but pointer coordinates already scale correctly; good.
No pagination on /api/receivals (to_list(1000)); acceptable for MVP but flag for scale.
seed_data_creation: None persistent — created and deleted a receival record during E2E. Backend tests use TEST_ prefix and clean up their own suppliers/statuses/staff/receivals.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (16 tests, all passing). Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from env or falls back to /app/frontend/.env. Auth is JWT Bearer (localStorage key 'eurasia_token'). Camera in headless: use file upload via data-testid='camera-file-input' (set_input_files). Signature: draw with mouse events on the canvas or the imperative ref returns null.
